name: metaculus-bot
setup: uv run --frozen --no-dev playwright install chromium || echo 'playwright install failed: the rendered-fetch rung degrades to plain fetch'

env_required.name: METACULUS_TOKEN
env_required.where: metaculus.com > Settings > My Forecasting Bots > Create a Bot, copy the API key

env_required.name: OPENROUTER_API_KEY
env_required.where: openrouter.ai > Settings > Keys > Create Key (it may stay unfunded: the free tier needs a key too)

env_optional.name: OAI_ANTH_OPENROUTER_KEY
env_optional.where: the OpenRouter key Metaculus emails you after the credit application (forms.gle/aQdYMq9Pisrf1v7d8)

env_optional.name: ASKNEWS_CLIENT_ID
env_optional.where: my.asknews.app > Settings > API credentials

env_optional.name: ASKNEWS_SECRET
env_optional.where: my.asknews.app > Settings > API credentials

env_optional.name: GEMINI_API_KEY
env_optional.where: aistudio.google.com > Get API key (Google AI Studio); also set GEMINI_SEARCH_ENABLED=true

env_optional.name: EXA_API_KEY
env_optional.where: exa.ai dashboard > API keys (not covered by donated credits)

env_optional.name: PERPLEXITY_API_KEY
env_optional.where: perplexity.ai > Settings > API

env_optional.name: FRED_API_KEY
env_optional.where: fred.stlouisfed.org > My Account > API Keys

env_optional.name: SEC_EDGAR_CONTACT_EMAIL
env_optional.where: any real contact email; sent as the SEC EDGAR User-Agent

env_optional.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
env_optional.where: platform.openai.com > API keys (the roster goes through OpenRouter and does not use it)

env_optional.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
env_optional.where: console.anthropic.com > API keys (the roster goes through OpenRouter and does not use it)

env_optional.name: MANTIC_TOKEN
env_optional.where: competitions.mantic.com bot token; arms the mantic workflow, about $3 per question on your OpenRouter key, and it ignores the zero-credit mode flags

env_optional.name: WORKFLOW_TOURNAMENT_ENABLED
env_optional.where: a switch, not a key: true or false (default true)

env_optional.name: WORKFLOW_MINIBENCH_ENABLED
env_optional.where: a switch, not a key: true or false (default true)

env_optional.name: WORKFLOW_MANTIC_ENABLED
env_optional.where: a switch, not a key: true or false (default true, idle until MANTIC_TOKEN exists)

env_optional.name: FORECASTER_FREE_TIER_ENABLED
env_optional.where: cost mode flag, default true: three free forecasters. Set false once credits land

env_optional.name: SUPPORT_MODEL_ROUTE
env_optional.where: cost mode flag, default free: text-only support roles on a free model (paid = their own models)

env_optional.name: GAP_FILL_ENABLED
env_optional.where: cost mode flag, default false: paid gap-fill v1 research (about $0.35 to $0.57 a question)

env_optional.name: GAP_FILL_V2_ENABLED
env_optional.where: cost mode flag, default false: paid agentic gap-fill v2 research (about $0.22 to $0.45 a question)

env_optional.name: NATIVE_SEARCH_ENABLED
env_optional.where: cost mode flag, default false: paid provider-native web search (about $0.13 to $0.22 a question)

env_optional.name: GEMINI_SEARCH_ENABLED
env_optional.where: cost mode flag, default false: Gemini grounded search, needs GEMINI_API_KEY

env_optional.name: OPENROUTER_CREDIT_FLOOR_USD
env_optional.where: early-warning balance in dollars, default 15 (upstream used 100 for a $1,500 grant)
